observations: Two diagonal beams of sharp yellow-green light cut from upper-left to lower-right, passing through clusters of soft white circles scattered across the lower half of the composition.
A large arched form near the upper-left center is outlined in white and black zigzag lines, enclosing nested rectangular shapes with two glowing spiral cores rendered in near-white yellow.
The overall field is dominated by olive and acid yellow-green, with pockets of red, blue, and purple visible beneath dense overlapping line work of zigzags, waves, and loose scribbles.
reading: The two hard diagonal beams slice through a field of restless surface — zigzag borders, looping scribbles, nested rectangles stacked like rooms inside rooms. Where the beams land, the olive-green ground goes pale and the scattered circles read as afterglow. The glowing spiral cores inside the arched form hold still against all that movement, and the tension between stillness and scatter gives the image its charge.
